GitHub Issue:
Post Date: 2018-12-14T07:40:12Z
Current Date: April 4 2025
Title: Delayed events do not keep order doOnNext and doOnComplete (groupBy with publish) 
Description: Hi,
I'm a bit confused about how doOnComplete works in example below. 
rxjava version: 2.2.4

```java
Flowable<String> emitter = Flowable.just("aa", "ba", "ab", "bb", "ac")
                .doOnComplete(() -> logger.info("End emit"));

        Flowable<GroupedFlowable<Character, String>> groupBy = emitter.groupBy(s -> s.charAt(0));

        groupBy.flatMap(characterStringGroupedFlowable -> stats(characterStringGroupedFlowable)
                .publish(stringFlowable -> stringFlowable.concatMap(s -> 
                     Flowable.just(s).delay(100, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS))))
                .subscribeOn(Schedulers.from(Executors.newFixedThreadPool(1)))
                .test()
                .await();
```
```java
private Flowable<String> stats(GroupedFlowable<Character, String> groupedFlowable) {
        return groupedFlowable.compose(upstream -> {
            AtomicLong count = new AtomicLong(0);
            return upstream
                    .doOnNext(s -> {
                        count.incrementAndGet();
                        logger.info("Group: {} - stats - [{}] - count: {}", 
                        groupedFlowable.getKey(), s, count.get());
                    })
                    .doOnComplete(() -> {
                        logger.info("Group: {} - stats - complete - count: {}", 
                        groupedFlowable.getKey(), count.get());
                    });

        });
    }
```
Output:
```
08:13:39.349 | INFO  | pool-1-thread-1 | Group: a - stats - [aa] - count: 1
08:13:39.355 | INFO  | pool-1-thread-1 | Group: b - stats - [ba] - count: 1
08:13:39.356 | INFO  | pool-1-thread-1 | Group: a - stats - [ab] - count: 2
08:13:39.356 | INFO  | pool-1-thread-1 | Group: b - stats - [bb] - count: 2
08:13:39.356 | INFO  | pool-1-thread-1 | End emit
08:13:39.356 | INFO  | pool-1-thread-1 | Group: a - stats - complete - count: 2
08:13:39.356 | INFO  | pool-1-thread-1 | Group: b - stats - complete - count: 2
08:13:39.459 | INFO  | RxComputationThreadPool-1 | Group: a - stats - [ac] - count: 3
```
I expected that this line `Group: a - stats - [ac] - count: 3` will be before that line `Group: a - stats - complete - count: 2`. I think it is a bug, of course I can be wrong. Removing `publish` operator solving a problem but in real world I need it to my business logic.
